mapper.select: select ci.id,ci.name,vc.is_share from coupon_common_info ci left join vouche_coupon vc on ci.id = vc.coupon_id where ci.type = 0 and (vc.activation_deadline is null or vc.activation_deadline >= now()) union all select ci.id,ci.name,vc.is_share from coupon_common_info ci left join discount_coupon vc on ci.id = vc.coupon_id where ci.type = 1 and (vc.activation_deadline is null or vc.activation_deadline >= now()) union all select ci.id,ci.name,vc.is_share from coupon_common_info ci left join package_coupon vc on ci.id = vc.coupon_id where ci.type = 2 and (vc.activation_deadline is null or vc.activation_deadline >= now()) union all select ci.id,ci.name,vc.is_share from coupon_common_info ci left join special_package_coupon vc on ci.id = vc.coupon_id where ci.type = 3 and (vc.activation_deadline is null or vc.activation_deadline >= now())
